name: Efficiency spread
rule: Archive a spread candidate only when the point-in-time model differs from the timestamped market by at least 3 points after all availability checks.
hypothesis: Small-sample team ratings regress toward a prior-season baseline; residual market disagreement may contain information.

name: Pace-adjusted total
rule: Archive a total candidate only when the point-in-time total differs from the timestamped market by at least 4 points after all availability checks.
hypothesis: Possession volume and opponent defensive efficiency jointly explain scoring level better than raw points alone.

name: Calibrated moneyline
signal: Calibrated win probability versus no-vig market
rule: Archive a moneyline candidate only when a leakage-tested probability exceeds the applicable no-vig market probability by at least 3 percentage points.
hypothesis: A calibrated scoring distribution may identify win-probability disagreement; this distribution is not yet verified.

name: Two-game parlay
signal: Two spread/total edges in distinct games
rule: Require two distinct games, each with a 3-point point-in-time edge, verified prices and an empirically validated joint outcome model.
hypothesis: Separate games reduce shared in-game mechanisms, but independence of the actual legs still requires evidence.

name: Three-game parlay
signal: Three spread/total edges in distinct games
rule: Require three distinct games, each with a 3-point point-in-time edge, verified prices and a validated three-leg joint model; otherwise register no pick.
hypothesis: Compounded pricing errors may exist, but tail dependence and error multiplication can dominate apparent edge.

name: Points plus assists combo
rule: Research threshold PTS>=25 and AST>=5; require a timestamped offered combo, positive net model edge of at least 3 percentage points and validated joint pricing. Thresholds are exploratory, not current market lines.
hypothesis: Scoring and assist opportunities share possession/usage drivers; marginal multiplication is not a valid price.

name: Points assists rebounds combo
rule: Research threshold PTS>=25, AST>=5 and REB>=5; require a timestamped offered combo, at least 3 percentage points of net model edge and a validated three-way joint model.
hypothesis: Pairwise correlation is insufficient to determine a three-leg joint probability; the exact joint event must be modeled or observed.

name: Distinct-game star points parlay
signal: Two player scoring props in distinct games
rule: Research Dončić PTS>=25 and Edwards PTS>=25 only on distinct scheduled games; require verified offered prices and a dependence-aware joint evaluation. Never pair the same shared game as independent legs.
hypothesis: Player scoring persistence is not evidence that separate betting outcomes are independent; calendar and slate effects remain possible.
